item_title.value: What can I do with a free account?

content.value: What can I do with a free account?
A free account covers one project, one editor and the full editing toolset, so you can build something real rather than a demo. The only limits are on published projects and monthly exports.

editor_settings.title: What can I do with a free account?

item_title.value: Do I need technical skills to get started?

content.value: Do I need technical skills to get started?
No. Everything is built visually and the templates give you a working starting point on day one. If you do write code, the API and webhooks are there when you want them.

editor_settings.title: Do I need technical skills to get started?

item_title.value: Can I import data from another tool?

content.value: Can I import data from another tool?
Yes — CSV and JSON imports are built in, alongside direct importers for the most common tools. Send a sample file and support will map the fields with you before you commit to a full migration.

editor_settings.title: Can I import data from another tool?

item_title.value: How is my data kept secure?

content.value: How is my data kept secure?
Everything is encrypted in transit and at rest, backed up daily, and hosted in the region you pick at signup. Access is logged, and you can require two-factor authentication across your whole team.

editor_settings.title: How is my data kept secure?

item_title.value: Does it work with the tools I already use?

content.value: Does it work with the tools I already use?
There are native integrations for the tools most teams already run, plus webhooks and a REST API for anything not on that list. Every integration can be switched off again without touching your data.

editor_settings.title: Does it work with the tools I already use?

item_title.value: What happens to my data if I cancel?

content.value: What happens to my data if I cancel?
You can export all of it at any point, before or after cancelling. Accounts stay recoverable for thirty days after the final billing period, and are permanently deleted after that.

editor_settings.title: What happens to my data if I cancel?
